```{r load-and-process-data, include=FALSE}
# Function to load and standardize navigation data
load_nav_data <- function(file_path, age_group) {
  data <- read.csv(file_path)
  
  data <- data %>%
    select(-1) %>%
    mutate(
      Group = age_group,
      Block_Num = as.factor(Block_Num)
    )
  
  return(data)
}

# Load navigation datasets
ya_nav_data <- load_nav_data(file.path(navcity_path, "ya_merged_results.csv"), "YA")
oa_nav_data <- load_nav_data(file.path(navcity_path, "oa_merged_results.csv"), "OA")

# Load non-navigation data
non_nav_data <- read.csv(file.path(paper_data_path, "non_nav_data.csv")) %>%
  select(-Group)

# Combine navigation datasets
all_nav_data <- bind_rows(ya_nav_data, oa_nav_data) %>%
  mutate(Age = factor(Group, levels = c("YA", "OA")))

print(paste("Loaded navigation data for", nrow(all_nav_data), "trials"))
print(paste("Loaded non-navigation data for", nrow(non_nav_data), "participants"))
```

```{r calculate-block-means, include=FALSE}
# Calculate per-participant per-block means
block_means <- all_nav_data %>%
  group_by(Participant, Block_Num, Age) %>%
  summarise(
    Total_Time = mean(Total_Time, na.rm = TRUE),
    Orientation_Time = mean(Orientation_Time, na.rm = TRUE),
    Navigation_Time = mean(Navigation_Time, na.rm = TRUE),
    Distance = mean(Distance, na.rm = TRUE),
    Speed = mean(Speed, na.rm = TRUE),
    Mean_Dwell = mean(Mean_Dwell, na.rm = TRUE),
    Teleportations = mean(Teleportations, na.rm = TRUE),
    Mean_Teleport_Distance = mean(Mean_Teleport_Distance, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = 'drop'
  )
```

```{r calculate-mean-scores-and-cohorts, include=FALSE}
# Calculate mean across all blocks for each participant (matches script 4 approach)
mean_scores <- block_means %>%
  group_by(Participant, Age) %>%
  summarise(
    Total_Time = mean(Total_Time, na.rm = TRUE),
    Orientation_Time = mean(Orientation_Time, na.rm = TRUE),
    Navigation_Time = mean(Navigation_Time, na.rm = TRUE),
    Distance = mean(Distance, na.rm = TRUE),
    Speed = mean(Speed, na.rm = TRUE),
    Mean_Dwell = mean(Mean_Dwell, na.rm = TRUE),
    Teleportations = mean(Teleportations, na.rm = TRUE),
    Mean_Teleport_Distance = mean(Mean_Teleport_Distance, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = 'drop'
  )

# Merge with NARA scores and create cohort labels (NARA cutoff = 3.5, matches script 6)
df_merge_mean <- mean_scores %>%
  left_join(non_nav_data, by = "Participant") %>%
  filter(!is.na(NARA)) %>%
  mutate(
    Cohort = case_when(
      Age == "YA" ~ "ya",
      Age == "OA" & NARA >= 3.5 ~ "oa_high",
      Age == "OA" & NARA <  3.5 ~ "oa_low",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),
    Cohort = factor(Cohort, levels = c("ya", "oa_high", "oa_low"))
  )

# OA-only dataset (the focus of this script)
df_oa <- df_merge_mean %>%
  filter(Cohort %in% c("oa_high", "oa_low")) %>%
  mutate(Cohort = factor(Cohort, levels = c("oa_high", "oa_low")))

# Per-cohort datasets for stats
oa_high_data <- filter(df_oa, Cohort == "oa_high")
oa_low_data  <- filter(df_oa, Cohort == "oa_low")

print("Cohort distribution (mean scores):")
print(table(df_merge_mean$Cohort, useNA = "ifany"))
print(paste("OAHigh participants:", nrow(oa_high_data)))
print(paste("OALow participants:",  nrow(oa_low_data)))
```

```{r calculate-change-scores, include=FALSE}
# OPTIONAL: also build change-score version for parity with script 4
change_scores <- block_means %>%
  filter(Block_Num %in% c("1", "3")) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = Block_Num,
    values_from = c(Total_Time, Orientation_Time, Navigation_Time,
                    Distance, Speed, Mean_Dwell, Teleportations, Mean_Teleport_Distance),
    names_sep = "_Block_"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Total_Time             = Total_Time_Block_3             - Total_Time_Block_1,
    Orientation_Time       = Orientation_Time_Block_3       - Orientation_Time_Block_1,
    Navigation_Time        = Navigation_Time_Block_3        - Navigation_Time_Block_1,
    Distance               = Distance_Block_3               - Distance_Block_1,
    Speed                  = Speed_Block_3                  - Speed_Block_1,
    Mean_Dwell             = Mean_Dwell_Block_3             - Mean_Dwell_Block_1,
    Teleportations         = Teleportations_Block_3         - Teleportations_Block_1,
    Mean_Teleport_Distance = Mean_Teleport_Distance_Block_3 - Mean_Teleport_Distance_Block_1
  ) %>%
  select(Participant, Age, Total_Time, Orientation_Time, Navigation_Time,
         Distance, Speed, Mean_Dwell, Teleportations, Mean_Teleport_Distance)

df_merge_change <- change_scores %>%
  left_join(non_nav_data, by = "Participant") %>%
  filter(!is.na(NARA)) %>%
  mutate(
    Cohort = case_when(
      Age == "YA" ~ "ya",
      Age == "OA" & NARA >= 3.5 ~ "oa_high",
      Age == "OA" & NARA <  3.5 ~ "oa_low",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ),
    Cohort = factor(Cohort, levels = c("ya", "oa_high", "oa_low"))
  )

df_oa_change <- df_merge_change %>%
  filter(Cohort %in% c("oa_high", "oa_low")) %>%
  mutate(Cohort = factor(Cohort, levels = c("oa_high", "oa_low")))
```

```{r plotting-functions, include=FALSE}
# Save plots helper
save_plot <- function(plot, filename, width = 5, height = 5) {
  ggsave(
    filename = file.path(output_path, paste0(filename, ".svg")),
    plot = plot,
    width = width,
    height = height
  )
  cat("Saved:", filename, "\n")
}

# Cohort palette (matches script 6: OAHigh = darker blue, OALow = lighter blue, YA = pink)
cohort_colors_oa <- c('oa_high' = '#325AF5', 'oa_low' = '#8A9AFF')
cohort_colors_all <- c('ya' = '#FF9FAF', 'oa_high' = '#325AF5', 'oa_low' = '#8A9AFF')

# OAHigh vs. OALow correlation plot
create_oa_corr_plot <- function(data, x_var, x_label, colors = cohort_colors_oa) {
  ggplot(data, aes(x = .data[[x_var]], y = NARA, color = Cohort, fill = Cohort)) +
    geom_point(size = 2, position = position_jitter(h = 0.18, w = 0)) +
    scale_color_manual(values = colors,
                       labels = c("oa_high" = expression(OA[High]),
                                  "oa_low"  = expression(OA[Low]))) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = colors,
                      labels = c("oa_high" = expression(OA[High]),
                                 "oa_low"  = expression(OA[Low]))) +
    scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 8), breaks = seq(0, 8, by = 1)) +
    stat_smooth(method = 'lm', formula = y ~ x) +
    labs(
      x = x_label,
      y = "NARA Score",
      color = "Cohort"
    ) +
    theme_classic() +
    theme(
      panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white", linewidth = 0.5, colour = "#242526"),
      axis.line = element_line(linewidth = 0.5, colour = "#242526"),
      axis.ticks = element_line(linewidth = 0.2, colour = "#242526"),
      plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5),
      axis.text.x = element_text(size = 20),
      axis.text.y = element_text(size = 20),
      axis.title.y = element_text(size = 20),
      axis.title.x = element_text(size = 20),
      legend.position = 'none'
    )
}

# 3-cohort version (YA + OAHigh + OALow) for context plots
create_three_cohort_corr_plot <- function(data, x_var, x_label, colors = cohort_colors_all) {
  ggplot(data, aes(x = .data[[x_var]], y = NARA, color = Cohort, fill = Cohort)) +
    geom_point(size = 2, position = position_jitter(h = 0.18, w = 0)) +
    scale_color_manual(values = colors) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = colors) +
    scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 8), breaks = seq(0, 8, by = 1)) +
    stat_smooth(method = 'lm', formula = y ~ x) +
    labs(
      x = x_label,
      y = "NARA Score",
      color = "Cohort"
    ) +
    theme_classic() +
    theme(
      panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white", linewidth = 0.5, colour = "#242526"),
      axis.line = element_line(linewidth = 0.5, colour = "#242526"),
      axis.ticks = element_line(linewidth = 0.2, colour = "#242526"),
      plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5),
      axis.text.x = element_text(size = 20),
      axis.text.y = element_text(size = 20),
      axis.title.y = element_text(size = 20),
      axis.title.x = element_text(size = 20),
      legend.position = 'none'
    )
}
```

```{r create-mean-score-plots, include=FALSE}
# Plot specifications matching script 4
plot_specs_mean <- tribble(
  ~var_name,                ~label,                                        ~plot_name,
  "Distance",               "Mean Distance Traveled (m)",                  "dt_mean",
  "Total_Time",             "Mean Total Time (s)",                         "ct_mean",
  "Orientation_Time",       "Mean Orientation Time (s)",                   "orict_mean",
  "Navigation_Time",        "Mean Navigation Time (s)",                    "navct_mean",
  "Speed",                  "Mean Speed (m/s)",                            "speed_mean",
  "Teleportations",         "Mean Teleportations (count)",                 "teleport_mean",
  "Mean_Dwell",             "Mean Dwell Duration (s)",                     "dwell_mean",
  "Mean_Teleport_Distance", "Mean Teleport Distance (m)",                  "teleport_dt_mean"
)

# OAHigh vs. OALow plots (the reviewer's specific request)
oa_plots_mean <- map2(plot_specs_mean$var_name, plot_specs_mean$label, function(var, label) {
  create_oa_corr_plot(df_oa, var, label)
})
names(oa_plots_mean) <- paste0("p_oa_", plot_specs_mean$plot_name)

# Three-cohort context plots (YA + OAHigh + OALow)
three_plots_mean <- map2(plot_specs_mean$var_name, plot_specs_mean$label, function(var, label) {
  create_three_cohort_corr_plot(df_merge_mean, var, label)
})
names(three_plots_mean) <- paste0("p_three_", plot_specs_mean$plot_name)

# Extract individual plots for easy reference (OA-only)
p_oa_dt_mean         <- oa_plots_mean$p_oa_dt_mean
p_oa_ct_mean         <- oa_plots_mean$p_oa_ct_mean
p_oa_orict_mean      <- oa_plots_mean$p_oa_orict_mean
p_oa_navct_mean      <- oa_plots_mean$p_oa_navct_mean
p_oa_speed_mean      <- oa_plots_mean$p_oa_speed_mean
p_oa_teleport_mean   <- oa_plots_mean$p_oa_teleport_mean

print("Created all OAHigh vs. OALow correlation plots (mean scores)")
print("Created all three-cohort correlation plots (mean scores)")
```

```{r correlation-statistics, include=FALSE}
# Spearman correlations for OAHigh vs. OALow on each primary and secondary outcome
# Matches the test used in script 4 / Fig 4 in the manuscript

run_spearman <- function(data, x_var, y_var = "NARA") {
  out <- suppressWarnings(cor.test(data[[x_var]], data[[y_var]], method = "spearman"))
  data.frame(
    rho      = unname(out$estimate),
    p        = out$p.value,
    n        = nrow(data)
  )
}

# Primary + secondary outcomes
all_outcomes <- plot_specs_mean$var_name

# Within-cohort correlations (mean scores)
cohort_corr_results <- map_dfr(all_outcomes, function(var) {
  rbind(
    data.frame(Cohort = "OAHigh", Outcome = var, run_spearman(oa_high_data, var)),
    data.frame(Cohort = "OALow",  Outcome = var, run_spearman(oa_low_data,  var))
  )
}) %>%
  mutate(
    rho = round(rho, 3),
    p   = round(p, 4)
  )

# Combined-OA correlations for context
oa_combined <- df_merge_mean %>% filter(Age == "OA")
combined_corr_results <- map_dfr(all_outcomes, function(var) {
  data.frame(Cohort = "All_OA", Outcome = var, run_spearman(oa_combined, var))
}) %>%
  mutate(
    rho = round(rho, 3),
    p   = round(p, 4)
  )

# YA correlations for full context
ya_combined <- df_merge_mean %>% filter(Age == "YA")
ya_corr_results <- map_dfr(all_outcomes, function(var) {
  data.frame(Cohort = "YA", Outcome = var, run_spearman(ya_combined, var))
}) %>%
  mutate(
    rho = round(rho, 3),
    p   = round(p, 4)
  )

# Combine into a single table
all_corr_results <- bind_rows(ya_corr_results, combined_corr_results, cohort_corr_results) %>%
  mutate(Cohort = factor(Cohort, levels = c("YA", "All_OA", "OAHigh", "OALow"))) %>%
  arrange(Outcome, Cohort)

print("Spearman correlations (NARA vs. each navigation outcome, averaged across blocks):")
print(all_corr_results)

# Save the table
write.csv(all_corr_results,
          file.path(output_path, "8_cohorts_corr_spearman_results.csv"),
          row.names = FALSE)
cat("Saved: 8_cohorts_corr_spearman_results.csv\n")
```

```{r fisher-z-comparisons, include=FALSE}
# Fisher's Z to test whether correlations differ between OAHigh and OALow
# (Same approach as the YA vs. OA Fisher's Z test in the manuscript)

fisher_z_test <- function(r1, n1, r2, n2) {
  # Spearman's rho can be Fisher-z transformed approximately the same way as Pearson r
  # for moderate sample sizes (Fieller et al., 1957; standard practice).
  # Note: variance approximation uses 1.06/(n-3) for Spearman vs. 1/(n-3) for Pearson,
  # but for consistency with the manuscript's existing YA-vs-OA Fisher's Z (which used
  # the standard form), we keep the same form here.
  z1 <- 0.5 * log((1 + r1) / (1 - r1))
  z2 <- 0.5 * log((1 + r2) / (1 - r2))
  se <- sqrt(1/(n1 - 3) + 1/(n2 - 3))
  z  <- (z1 - z2) / se
  p  <- 2 * (1 - pnorm(abs(z)))
  data.frame(z = round(z, 3), p = round(p, 4))
}

n_high <- nrow(oa_high_data)
n_low  <- nrow(oa_low_data)

fisher_results <- map_dfr(all_outcomes, function(var) {
  r_high <- cohort_corr_results %>% filter(Cohort == "OAHigh", Outcome == var) %>% pull(rho)
  r_low  <- cohort_corr_results %>% filter(Cohort == "OALow",  Outcome == var) %>% pull(rho)
  data.frame(
    Outcome = var,
    rho_OAHigh = r_high,
    rho_OALow  = r_low,
    n_OAHigh = n_high,
    n_OALow  = n_low,
    fisher_z_test(r_high, n_high, r_low, n_low)
  )
})

print("Fisher's Z comparison: OAHigh vs. OALow correlations")
print(fisher_results)

write.csv(fisher_results,
          file.path(output_path, "8_cohorts_corr_fisher_z_results.csv"),
          row.names = FALSE)
cat("Saved: 8_cohorts_corr_fisher_z_results.csv\n")
```

```{r summary-statistics, include=FALSE}
# Descriptive statistics by cohort
cohort_descriptive_stats <- df_merge_mean %>%
  group_by(Cohort) %>%
  summarise(
    n = n(),
    across(c(NARA, Total_Time, Orientation_Time, Navigation_Time, Distance,
             Speed, Mean_Dwell, Teleportations, Mean_Teleport_Distance),
           list(mean = ~ round(mean(.x, na.rm = TRUE), 2),
                sd   = ~ round(sd(.x,   na.rm = TRUE), 2)),
           .names = "{.col}_{.fn}"),
    .groups = 'drop'
  )

print("Descriptive statistics by cohort (mean scores):")
print(cohort_descriptive_stats)

# Range of NARA scores by cohort - useful for the range-restriction caveat
nara_ranges <- df_merge_mean %>%
  group_by(Cohort) %>%
  summarise(
    n = n(),
    nara_min = min(NARA, na.rm = TRUE),
    nara_max = max(NARA, na.rm = TRUE),
    nara_range = nara_max - nara_min,
    nara_sd = round(sd(NARA, na.rm = TRUE), 2),
    .groups = 'drop'
  )

print("NARA score ranges by cohort (relevant for range-restriction interpretation):")
print(nara_ranges)
```
